title: Studio: the object and field inspectors author what the v3 record page reads — `relatedList` (show / hide / primary), related-list columns / filter / limit on the block, and a new record page starts empty instead of a copy of the synthesized regions
body:
Unblocked 2026-10-28T14:04Z — #27069 merged as PR #27215 (`c63ce2ad72`): `ObjectSchema.relatedLists` and the field group's `relatedList` placement entry are on `main`. Round 2 of this card (the `relatedLists` drag-to-order editor) is dispatched on branch `claude/issue-27054-related-lists-editor`.

(#27069 merged 2026-10-28T13:28Z.) Four of five items landed in PR #27163 (merged 2026-10-28T11:02Z, `Part of`): the `relatedList` three-state control with the filter builder, the `record:related_list` block inspector props, ordered `highlightFields`, and slotted-by-default record pages. The fifth — the `relatedLists` drag-to-order editor — waits for #27069 to ship the key; this card stays open for it.

Part of the record-page-v3 epic #26676 (v3 child 6 of 8). Independent of the record-page series (Studio files only, plus a spec form file); the `relatedLists` editor lands after #27069 ships the key (that item waits, the rest does not).

## Source (origin/main `7bb8084590`)

- `relatedList: true | false | 'primary'` (`field.zod.ts:1725`) has no Studio control: `field.form.ts` offers `relatedListTitle` / `Columns` / `Filter` rows only and `ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:35` says the inverse-collection control 「is a spec card」. `relatedListFilter`'s widget renders raw JSON.
- `record:related_list`'s inspector (`previews/block-config.ts:513-518`) exposes `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `title`, `limit` — not `columns`, `sort`, `filter`, `actions`, `add`.
- `metadata-admin/anchors.ts:207-221`: creating a `record` page seeds it with the synthesized page's regions and template, so every authored page starts as a fork of the default and drifts from it.
- `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` edits `nameField`, `stageField`, `highlightFields`, `enable.*` but `highlightFields` has no ordered picker (order is what the highlight strip draws).

## Target

1. Field inspector: a three-state 「关联列表」 control (显示 / 不显示 / 主要) on lookup and master_detail fields writing `relatedList`; `relatedListFilter` gets the filter-condition builder the list view uses, not raw JSON.
2. `record:related_list` block inspector: `columns` (string tags of the child's fields), `sort`, `filter` (same builder), `limit`, `showViewAll`, `add` — the props the node already declares (`component.zod.ts:1574`).
3. Object settings: `relatedLists` (#27069) as a drag-to-order list of the object's inbound relationships (child object · field, with 「未列出的按默认顺序」 shown greyed below), and `highlightFields` as an ordered multi-select (drag to reorder, max 6), with a live preview of the strip.
4. New record page: starts as `kind: slotted` with no slots (= the synthesized default) and a one-line explanation; 「转成整页」 is an explicit action that copies the regions on demand. The create form's `kind` default and `anchors.ts` seed change accordingly.
5. The objectstack-ui skill is not touched here (#27059).

## File surface

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/{anchors.ts,ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx,inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx}`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/**` (block-config, PageBlockInspector), `packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts` and `packages/spec/src/ui/page.form.ts` (form rows only — no schema change; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), i18n, tests beside, changesets.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: setting 「主要」 on the task → lead FK writes `relatedList: 'primary'` and the synthesized lead page puts tasks first; the block inspector round-trips `columns` / `filter` / `limit`; a new record page is created with `kind: slotted` and empty slots; `highlightFields` order is preserved.
2. Screenshots: the field inspector with the three-state control; the new-page dialog.

## Rulings (maintainer, chat in the filing session, 2026-10-28 — verbatim, not re-decidable here)

1. Record-page model (2026-10-27): 「1. 一个对象一个默认打开方式：默认抽屉（带展开整页），`page` 只给显式声明的对象，`modal` 退役，split / popover 变成用户个人偏好；抽屉和整页是同一张页在两个宽度。」
2. On the resident timeline column: 「时间线是不是太突出了，这个只适合部分对象吧？适合做所有业务对象的默认布局吗」 and then 「时间线是否显示，是否可以切换，比如当前版本的 Claude code，顶部有很多切换图标」 — the column's presence is a per-user toggle with an object-derived default, never metadata.
3. On the related column's cost: 「关联都放在右侧，记录打开时是不是会很慢，因为需要加载所有的关联子表。」 — the related column loads counts first, rows on demand, and never blocks the details.
4. On mobile: 「还要考虑手机端的效果。」
5. On the definition surfaces: the PM's keep / narrow / retire table was put to the maintainer (keep object roles, relationship flags, six slotted slots and `kind: full`; retire the `tabs` slot and the dead `BuildPageOptions` hints; fold the quick-look path into the one record page) and approved with the instruction in the footer.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 under epic #26676 (record page v2 → v3), from the record-page definition-surface inventory on objectstack main `7bb8084590` and the maintainer's rulings in that session. The maintainer's instruction to file and dispatch, verbatim: 「同意，以上界面相关的需要我确认的你负责立卡派发，如果有可能可以启动云会话，开发完你来确认。」 Design evidence: the design canvas boards 「记录页 v3」 row (RecordPageV3, RecordPageV3NoTimeline, RecordPageRef, RecordDrawerV3, RecordMobile) — exported to the never-merged branch named in the epic parent once this batch is filed.</sub>
